title: 第1章 寝室
content_zh:
一个昏暗而且烟雾缭绕的宿舍里面，三个男生都是光着膀子穿着大裤衩子坐在一起，玩着斗地主，其中一个人又高又瘦，旁边那个，却是肥嘟嘟的，坐床上那个，身材相对标准了不少，不过肚子上同样带着个小肚腩。

毫无疑问，三人便是传说之中的现代大学生了，当然了，其实他们大多数时间是对着电脑的，不过今天学校停电了，没法上网了，三人就只好玩玩斗地主了。

这一把，身材相对标准的展飞是地主，刚刚出了一条A，然后直接便被下家的胖子，名为周泰的室友用一条二给拍死了，展飞挥手把周身的烟雾驱散了一些，开口道：“你们这群阉人啊，不知道抽烟有啥好的，呛死我了！小王！”

高瘦个子的那个家伙，名为郭鑫，一边吐着烟圈，一边开口道：“你懂什么，饭后一支烟，赛过活神仙，大王拍死！”

展飞听了，道：“饭后一支烟，从起床到现在，你吃过饭了吗？炸弹！”

确实，这个宿舍人的四个家伙，除了已经出去学习的刘元之外，其他人都是相当糜烂的，早饭十天最多有一天吃的，午饭也不出门，等自习回来的刘元把午饭带回来，然后利索的把饭吃完，就继续对着电脑了。

至于上课，只有一些必点名老师的课他们才会去上了，一天基本上也就上一节课，这种生活，无论是努力学习的高中生，还是大学毕业已经工作的社会人士，都是异常的羡慕的。

而就在展飞刚刚出炸弹，就要一定胜负的时候，灯却忽然亮了，一直到现在，终于他娘的来电了！

随即，三人都是把手中的扑克一扔，以一个恐怖的速度跑向了自己的床位，然后打开了电脑，三人都是口中念念有辞，郭鑫口中道：“草，今天的大三环还没跑呢！”

周泰则是道：“我的小女友等我好久了吧？”

展飞的话，则是道：“这次的突破任务又泡汤了，他乃乃的！”

展飞玩的是一款名为‘斗破大陆’的游戏，这款游戏相对来讲，还是比较平衡的，也是展飞玩了这两年时间游戏，唯一一款不用被软妹币玩家虐的太厉害的游戏，而这个游戏难就难在突破了，每隔二十级，有一个难度极高的突破任务，需要请一些高等级的帮忙突破。

那些高等级的玩家，时间都很有限，展飞好不容易和几个一百多级的高手说好了，第二天早上帮忙突破的，结果，停了一早上的电，而等展飞跑到网吧想要突破的时候，整个网吧早已经人满为患了。

否则的话，这宿舍三人组即便是出去上网，也不会呆在寝室斗地主的，而现在终于来电了，展飞也是立马上线，接着，好几个消息提示弹了出来，大致都是问展飞的情况。

那些一百多级的高级玩家，为了展飞，刻意跑到盘丝洞等待了十几分钟呢，展飞也一直不上线，然后咒骂了几句，就直接把展飞给拉黑了，而展飞也是欲哭无泪，高等级的玩家本来就难找，自己游戏圈子里，也就认识这么几个，现在一次性得罪光了，这该怎么突破啊？

随即展飞把心一横，不管了，大不了多挂几次，就不相信过不了这个任务！

随即，展飞操控着自己的那个号孤身一个人冲进了盘丝洞，这个任务是盘丝洞，自然了，里面的大boss乃是一只蜘蛛精，一只巨大的蜘蛛精，展飞的角色乃是召唤系，能够召唤宠物。

他如今八十九级的等级，可以召唤五头石蟒五头火狮，石蟒是物理攻击外加防御系的，火狮则完全是法攻型的，刷任务什么的，还是很给力的，不过单挑这个蜘蛛精，就差了太多了，那只蜘蛛精尾巴一扫，五头石蟒三只直接挂掉了，另外两只也残血了。

来不及展飞再次召唤，蜘蛛精已经发动了下一波攻击，这一回，剩下两只石蟒也挂掉了，而火狮喷射的火焰光柱每秒钟让蜘蛛精减少的血量不过是个位数，这相比蜘蛛精那数百万的血量，连血皮都没有减少分毫，因为这蜘蛛精自动回血速度每秒钟都过千呢！

而借着，蜘蛛精一个群攻把展飞的火狮也全秒了，失去了宠物吸引仇恨，蜘蛛精也是瞬间冲到了展飞那个角色的身前，一招下去，展飞的角色直接便挂掉了。

而展飞也是气的一拍桌子，不过他并没有注意到，就在桌子的一边，一杯水在展飞这么一拍之下，直接翻到了，水直接便流到了边上的插座上面，也流到了边上展飞抓着鼠标的手上面。

而展飞也是忽然感觉触碰到了什么湿湿的东西，然后直接便不省人事了，而电脑却依然开着，只不过，展飞那个挂掉的角色，却是没有像是往常一样，出现在轮回司，而是消失不见了，而游戏开了一会儿，上面也弹出了一个“参数错误”的提示，然后自动退出游戏了。

展飞被点晕了过去，两名室友自然是不知道了，周泰带着耳机，和自己的网上女友妮妮聊的热火朝天，而郭鑫也正做着三环任务呢，展飞自己，也没有什么大动静，不过是朝后栽倒在了床上，看上去就像是睡着了一样，自然不会有人打扰他的美梦了。

仿佛过了一秒钟，又或者一个世纪那么长，展飞骤然睁开了眼睛，如果有人在他对面的话，就能看到他眼中一丝蓝光一闪而过，而展飞也是抓了抓脑袋，然后便回忆起来，貌似自己刚才触电了啊，还好没挂！

随即展飞看了一眼还在玩游戏的两个哥们儿，然后口中道：“哥哥我差点挂了，你们都不知道呢！”

展飞说着，拿着干毛巾把电脑桌上面的水擦了擦，然后便准备继续自己的游戏了，区区意外，却不能让展飞中断自己的突破大业！只不过，等展飞再次登陆游戏的时候，游戏系统却提示，该角色并不存在！
content_en:
In a dark and smoky dormitory, three boys were sitting together shirtless and wearing big underpants, playing a game of landlords. One of them was tall and thin, but the one next to him was plump. The one sitting on the bed had a relatively standard figure, but he also had a small belly.

There is no doubt that the three of them are the legendary modern college students. Of course, they actually spend most of their time in front of the computer. However, today the school has a power outage and cannot access the Internet, so the three of them have no choice but to play Landlords.

This time, Zhan Fei, a landowner with a relatively standard figure, had just made an ace, and then was directly beaten to death by a fat man named Zhou Tai, a roommate from the next family, with a two. Zhan Fei waved his hand to disperse some of the smoke around him, and said: "You eunuchs, you don't know what's good about smoking, you're choking me to death! Xiao Wang!"

The tall and thin guy, named Guo Xin, blew out smoke rings and said, "What do you know? A cigarette after a meal is better than a living god, and I will kill you!"

Zhan Fei listened and said: "A cigarette after a meal. Have you eaten since you got up? Bomb!"

Indeed, the four guys in this dormitory, except for Liu Yuan who has gone out to study, the others are quite rotten. They eat breakfast only one day in ten days at most, and don't go out for lunch. Liu Yuan, who is waiting for the self-study to come back, brings lunch back, then finishes the meal neatly, and continues to face the computer.

As for classes, they only attend those classes where the teacher must be named, and basically only attend one class a day. This kind of life is extremely enviable for both high school students who study hard and people who have graduated from college and are already working.

And just when Zhan Fei had just released the bomb and was about to determine the outcome, the light suddenly came on. Until now, the damn call finally came!

Immediately, the three of them threw away the cards in their hands, ran to their beds at a terrifying speed, and then turned on the computer. All three of them muttered something. Guo Xin said: "Fuck, today's third ring road hasn't run yet!"

Zhou Taize said: "My little girlfriend has been waiting for me for a long time, right?"

Zhan Fei said: "This breakthrough mission has failed again, and it belongs to him!"

Zhan Fei plays a game called "Fighting Breaking the Continent". This game is relatively balanced. It is also the only game that Zhan Fei has played in the past two years that does not require too much abuse from soft sister players. The difficulty of this game is to break through. Every twenty levels, there is an extremely difficult breakthrough mission, and you need to ask some high-level people to help break through.

Those high-level players had limited time. Zhan Fei finally made an agreement with several masters of over 100 levels to help break through the next morning. As a result, the power was out all morning, and when Zhan Fei went to the Internet cafe to break through, the entire Internet cafe was already overcrowded.

Otherwise, even if the dormitory trio went out to surf the Internet, they would not stay in the dormitory to play Landlords. Now that the call finally came, Zhan Fei immediately went online. Then, several message prompts popped up, mostly asking about Zhan Fei's situation.

Those high-level players who were over 100 levels deliberately went to Pansi Cave and waited for more than ten minutes for Zhan Fei. Zhan Fei was still offline, and then he cursed a few words and blocked Zhan Fei directly. Zhan Fei also wanted to cry without tears. High-level players are hard to find in the first place. He only knows a few in his own gaming circle. Now that he has offended them all at once, how can he break through?

Then Zhan Fei changed his mind and ignored it. At worst, if he failed a few more times, he would not believe that he would not be able to pass this task!

Immediately, Zhan Fei controlled his own account and rushed into the Pansi Cave alone. This mission was the Pansi Cave. Naturally, the big boss inside was a spider spirit, a huge spider spirit. Zhan Fei's role was a summoning system and could summon pets.

He is currently at level 89, and can summon five stone pythons and five fire lions. The stone pythons are physical attacks plus defense, while the fire lions are completely magic attack type. They are still very powerful for completing tasks, but they are far behind in single combat with this spider spirit. With a sweep of the tail of the spider spirit, three of the five stone pythons died directly, and the other two also had residual health.

Before Zhan Fei could summon him again, the spider spirit had already launched the next wave of attacks. This time, the remaining two stone pythons were also killed, and the flame beams sprayed by the fire lion only reduced the spider spirit's blood volume by single digits every second. Compared with the millions of blood volume of the spider spirit, even the blood skin was not reduced at all, because the spider spirit's automatic blood recovery rate was over a thousand per second!

And with this, the Spider Spirit's group attack knocked out Zhan Fei's Fire Lion. Without his pet to attract hatred, the Spider Spirit instantly rushed in front of Zhan Fei's character. With one move, Zhan Fei's character died immediately.

Zhan Fei also slapped the table angrily, but he didn't notice that on one side of the table, a glass of water fell over with Zhan Fei's slap. The water flowed directly to the socket on the side, and also flowed to Zhan Fei's hand holding the mouse.

And Zhan Fei also suddenly felt that he touched something wet, and then fell unconscious directly, while the computer was still on. However, Zhan Fei's dead character did not appear in the Reincarnation Department as usual, but disappeared. After the game was played for a while, a "parameter error" message popped up, and then it automatically exited the game.

Zhan Fei was knocked unconscious, and the two roommates naturally didn't know. Zhou Tai was wearing headphones and chatting enthusiastically with his online girlfriend Nini, while Guo Xin was also doing the three-ring task. Zhan Fei himself didn't make much movement, but fell backwards on the bed, looking like he was asleep. Naturally, no one would disturb his sweet dream.

As if a second had passed, or as long as a century, Zhan Fei suddenly opened his eyes. If someone was opposite him, he could see a flash of blue light in his eyes. Zhan Fei also scratched his head, and then recalled that it seemed that he had been electrocuted just now. Fortunately, he was not dead!

Then Zhan Fei glanced at his two buddies who were still playing the game, and then said: "Brother, I almost died, and you don't even know it!"

Zhan Fei said, wiped the water on the computer desk with a dry towel, and then prepared to continue his game. It was just an accident, but Zhan Fei could not let Zhan Fei interrupt his breakthrough!However, when Zhanfei logged into the game again, the game system prompted that the character did not exist!
